overview: A Thai-language coaching log for a chat sales team, where only people on an approved email list can sign in and each person sees their own records.
features: Sign in with Internet Identity and get checked against an approved email list
See your display name and role in the app header
A clear Thai message and sign-out button when your email is not on the list
Record training, coaching and outbound chat sessions with dates, times and approvers
Review past records filtered by date, email and status, with a per-person summary
